theater: 費爾干納河谷與碎葉前線

battle.name: 坦特基尼奇的戰爭
battle.theater: 費爾干納河谷與碎葉前線
battle.brief: 大曆十三年（778），阿拔斯帝國聯同突騎施鐵騎沿錐爾河進逼費爾干納，唐朝自安西、北庭調來的援軍在坦特基尼奇一線被迎頭擊潰，碎葉與拔汗那的城砦相繼失守，唐軍退回龜茲。卡面投石機並未隨軍西來，但它代表的攻城砲車技術正是這條戰線的勝負手：野戰崩盤之後，攻城方再靠砲車與圍城拿下城牆。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 這場戰爭是 778 年唐朝與阿拔斯帝國及其盟友突騎施在中亞費爾干納河谷爆發的邊境戰役。開戰時唐朝皇帝是唐代宗，年號大曆十三年，國都在長安；安史之亂自 755 年起把關中的兵與錢拖進中原，763 年吐蕃攻陷長安並取走河西，唐朝在西域的藩屬體系只剩空殼。交戰的另一方是阿拔斯帝國，其時由呼羅珊人建立的王朝執政，哈里發曼蘇爾於 775 年病逝後由其子馬赫迪即位；這支部隊以波斯呼羅珊為基地，750 年取撒馬爾罕，775 年取木鹿與內沙，穩住河中地區的門戶。第三方是突騎施鐵騎，其可汗蘇祿曾受唐封為歸義可汗，766 年被部下所殺後部眾分裂，但碎葉、怛羅斯一帶的綠洲與牧場仍在突騎施手中，於是與阿拔斯結盟對唐。吐蕃雖未直接參戰，卻控制河西走廊，切斷唐朝向西域輸送兵員與糧秣的陸路，那才是這場戰役真正的背景。
countriesEn: This war was a frontier clash fought in 778 between the Tang dynasty on one side and the Abbasid caliphate together with its Turgesh allies in the Fergana valley of Central Asia. When it began, the Tang emperor was Emperor Daizong, in the thirteenth year of the Dali era, with the capital at Chang'an. The An Lushan rebellion from 755 onward had drained the troops and the money of the Guanzhong heartland, and in 763 the Tibetans took Chang'an and cut away Hexi, so the Tang apparatus of client states in the West survived as an empty shell. The other side was the Abbasid caliphate, then ruled by the dynasty founded by the Khurramites, the Persians; the caliph al-Mansur had died in 775 and was succeeded by his son al-Mahdi. These armies drew on Persian Khurasan as their base, took Samarkand in 750, and took Merv and Nishapur in 775, holding the door into Transoxiana. The third party was the Turgesh cavalry, whose khagan Suluk had been invested by the Tang as Qiyi khagan; he was killed by his own men in 766 and the tribes split, but the oases and pastures around Suyab and Talas were still Turgesh-held, so the Turgesh joined the Abbasids against the Tang. Tibet did not fight in the battle, yet by holding the Hexi corridor it cut the land road through which the Tang could feed and reinforce its western garrisons, and that was the real background of the engagement.
people: 關於坦特基尼奇一役的將領，漢文方面的記載極為簡略，《新唐書·西域傳》與《資治通鑑》只留下輪廓，多數姓名不可考，但有幾個角色可以確定。朝廷一端，主政者是唐代宗李豫，大曆十三年他已年過六十，朝中由宰相與中書令掌兵案；安史之亂後募兵制逐步取代府兵，出征西域的漢軍多為募兵與長期駐防的蕃漢混編隊伍，統兵者往往以節度使、都護的身份出鎮，史籍沒能在本役留下主帥姓名。可以點名的，是三段較早的相關人物。其一是天寶十載（751）怛羅斯之戰的唐軍主帥高仙芝，葛邏祿部眾在那一役以投石機攻打怛羅斯小石城，漢軍在西域的經營由此轉為守勢。其二是突騎施先可汗蘇祿，他受唐冊封又與吐蕃往來，終究死在自家部眾的刀下，突騎施的分裂使 778 年的聯軍無法統一指揮。其三是阿拔斯哈里發馬赫迪，778 年的進攻在他的統治下發動，阿拔斯一方的主將姓名在漢文史籍中並無記載。
peopleEn: The record of the commanders at Tondibi is extremely thin. The chapter on the Western Regions in the New Book of Tang and the Comprehensive Mirror to Aid in Government preserve only an outline, and most personal names cannot be recovered, but several roles can be fixed. On the court side the government was in the hands of Emperor Daizong, Li Yu, already past sixty years of age in the thirteenth year of Dali, with the chancellors and the Secretariat handling military affairs. After the An Lushan rebellion the fubing militia was being replaced by recruited troops, and the Han forces sent west were recruited soldiers and long-service garrisons of mixed Han and foreign men, commanded by men who held the titles of jiedushi or protector, and no historian left the name of the field commander of this campaign. Three earlier figures can be named. The first is Gao Xianzhi, commander of the Tang army at the Battle of Talas in the tenth year of Tianbao (751), where the Karluks used stone-throwing engines against the small stone fortress of Talas and the Tang position in the West turned defensive. The second is Suluk, the first Turgesh khagan, who was invested by the Tang, dealt with Tibet, and was finally killed by his own men, and whose death left the Turgesh too divided to be commanded as one in 778. The third is the Abbasid caliph al-Mahdi, under whose rule the offensive of 778 was launched; the name of the Abbasid commander is not preserved in the Chinese sources.
kits: 投石機在這場戰爭裡的位置是象徵性的，卻並非不相干。卡面這具羅馬式投石機是把儲存的機械勢能一次換成一塊石頭的攻城機具，晚期羅馬與拜占庭的技術譜系在中亞早已被配重式砲車取代，但兩者原理相同：把繃緊的簧力或懸起的配重轉成拋射動能，去攻擊城牆、壘壁與密集隊形。東戰場的記載裡這類機具真實出現過：天寶十載怛羅斯之戰，葛邏祿人攻打怛羅斯小石城即用石砲連發，漢軍守城為之震動。778 年的戰線同樣是一條攻城線：阿拔斯與突騎施聯軍要拔掉唐朝在碎葉、拔汗那的城砦，靠的不是野戰一決，而是砲車連續轟擊加上斷水斷糧；唐軍守軍則以床弩、飛石與城頭弓弩反擊。聯軍最後能打下城，靠的正是攻城砲車打開缺口，而唐軍援兵在野戰中潰散，兩件事互相呼應。除投石機一類的攻城機具，這條戰線上還有唐代的橫刀、方樁戟與長槍，弓弩配以機動的騎兵聯隊，以及聯軍一方的彎刀、重裝步兵與波斯式騎兵。馬匹是攻方最吃緊的東西，費爾干納與碎葉之間的牧場有限，軍馬草料得從後方基地逐段接運，一處受阻，整條線就跟著慢下來。
kitsEn: The position of the onager in this war is symbolic rather than literal, but it is not irrelevant. The Roman onager on the card converts stored mechanical energy into a single stone; the late Roman and Byzantine line of such engines had already been overtaken in Central Asia by counterweight trebuchets, yet the principle is the same in both, since a tightened spring or a suspended weight is turned into the kinetic energy of a projectile aimed at walls, ramparts and dense formations. The engine really does appear in the record of this front: at the Battle of Talas in the tenth year of Tianbao (751) the Karluks assaulted the small stone fortress of Talas with stone-throwing engines fired in succession, and the Han defenders were shaken by them. The front of 778 was a siege front as well. What the Abbasid-Turgesh coalition needed to take the Tang forts at Suyab and Fergana was not a single field action but continuous bombardment from stone-throwing engines combined with the cutting of water and supplies, while the Tang garrisons answered with bed crossbows, hand-thrown stones and archers from the ramparts. The coalition took the walls because the engines opened a breach, and the Tang relief army had already disintegrated in the open field; the two facts answer each other. Besides engines of this class, the front carried the Tang hengdao, the square-pole ji and the long spear, bows and crossbows with mobile mounted companies, and on the coalition side curved sabres, heavy infantry in mail and Persian-style horsemen. Horses were the tightest resource for the attackers; the pastures between Fergana and Suyab were limited, and fodder for the campaign horses had to be carried forward stage by stage from the rear bases, so that one point of delay slowed the whole line.
tactics: 阿拔斯與突騎施聯軍的戰法是先以騎兵機動，再用圍城機具與封鎖線擠壓守軍。長達數千里的補給線由木鹿、撒馬爾罕一線接續，騎兵小隊沿錐爾河與費爾干納河谷的綠洲快速推進，拔除唐軍前哨與烽燧，再以砲車與步卒圍攻碎葉、拔汗那一帶城砦；聯軍的目標是迫使唐廷放棄中亞，而不是占領塔里木盆地。當唐軍援軍自東趕到，聯軍刻意不與其在開闊地正面交鋒，而是退入費爾干納南部的山間谷地，藉山勢與灌溉綠洲限制騎兵展開，再以步騎夾擊，把唐軍隊形切割成無法互相支援的段落。唐軍方面的戰術仍是漢地帶來的方陣與長蛇陣，步騎混編，輜重隨行，企圖以一次正面衝鋒扭轉局面；但隊伍遠離城池與補給點，糧秣靠隨軍攜帶與就地徵發，一旦退路被切斷，前鋒與後衛各自為戰，陣形很快瓦解。撤退階段最為要命：隊伍被壓入谷地，糧道斷絕，軍械與旗鼓大量遺棄，騎兵在慌亂中被逐次分割，最後成建制的部隊無人生還。攻城階段則完全是另一套節奏：先斷水，再築壘，最後才以石砲覆蓋城頭，逼守軍在缺口形成的瞬間暴露在步兵面前。
tacticsEn: The Abbasid-Turgesh coalition fought by moving first with cavalry and then squeezing the garrisons with siege engines and lines of blockade. A supply line thousands of li long was threaded from Merv and Samarkand; small mounted detachments pushed quickly along the Syr Darya and up the green valleys of the Fergana river, striking out the Tang outposts and beacon stations, and then brought up the engines and the infantry to invest the forts around Suyab and Fergana. The coalition's aim was to force the Tang court to abandon Central Asia, not to occupy the Tarim basin. When the Tang relief army came in from the east, the coalition deliberately avoided meeting it in open ground and instead withdrew into the valleys of southern Fergana, using the hills and the irrigated oases to limit the deployment of cavalry, and then struck the Tang from both sides and cut their formation into segments that could not support each other. The Tang on their side fought with formations carried over from the Han homeland, squares and coiled lines, infantry and cavalry combined, trains of baggage following behind, aiming to reverse the situation in one frontal charge. But the troops were far from any city or supply point, carrying grain and depending on local requisition, and once the line of retreat was cut the vanguard and the rear each fought alone and the order broke down quickly. The withdrawal was the worst of it: the column was pressed into the valley, the supply route was severed, arms and banners were abandoned wholesale, the mounted men were cut off piecemeal in the confusion, and in the end no organized body came out. The siege phase ran on a different rhythm altogether, cutting the water first, raising the works, and only then covering the rampart with stones so that the defenders were exposed to the infantry at the moment the breach opened.
data: 可以確定的數字不多，但有幾個坐標。時間：戰役發生在 778 年，即唐代宗大曆十三年；同一條戰線上一次大規模交手是 751 年的怛羅斯之戰，葛邏祿部眾數萬，大食調集諸國兵力，漢軍以蕃漢三萬出發，葛邏祿以投石機久攻小石城，相持數十日之後小石城陷落。地理：戰場在費爾干納河谷南部，與碎葉、怛羅斯構成同一條防線；從長安到戰場直線約三千公里，軍隊須繞塔里木盆地北緣，實際行程四千公里以上。城池：碎葉是唐代西域大城之一，城周數里，城內駐有軍府與官署；拔汗那為綠洲城國，控弦之眾與戶口在歷代冊封文獻中都有估算，各書數目不一，本役無從核對。兵力：本役的具體數目在漢文材料中沒有留下來，只能確定兩點：聯軍遠道而來，投入的是中亞騎兵與阿拔斯的重裝步兵；唐軍則由安西、北庭調來的漢兵與當地蕃兵組成，總量以萬計。野戰失利之後，唐軍的損失是整支隊伍的潰散、被殲與被俘，軍械與馬匹大量遺棄於戰場，攻城方則以砲車換下了城砦。時間跨度：從聯軍出兵到唐廷不再爭取塔里木以北的據點，前後約兩三年。
dataEn: Few numbers survive, but a few are firm. Date: the battle was fought in 778, the thirteenth year of the Dali era of Emperor Daizong; the last large engagement on the same front was the Battle of Talas in 751, where the Karluks brought tens of thousands, the Abbasids gathered contingents from several states, and the Han army marched out with some thirty thousand Han and foreign soldiers, while the Karluks battered the small stone fortress of Talas with stone-throwing engines and the siege ran on for tens of days before the fortress fell. Geography: the field lay in the southern Fergana valley, forming one defensive line together with Suyab and Talas. The straight-line distance from Chang'an to the battlefield is about three thousand kilometres, and an army had to skirt the northern rim of the Tarim basin, so the road march ran well over four thousand. The towns: Suyab was one of the great cities of the Tang western regions, several li around its walls, with military offices and garrisons inside; Fergana was an oasis state whose armed households and population were estimated in the documents of investiture, and the figures differ from book to book and cannot be checked against this campaign. Numbers of men: the Chinese materials give no exact figure for this battle, and only two things can be said. The coalition marched a long way and fed itself with Central Asian cavalry and Abbasid heavy infantry; the Tang brought Han troops from Anxi and Beiting together with local foreign soldiers, on the order of tens of thousands. After the defeat in the open field the Tang loss was the disintegration of the whole column, the killed and the taken, with arms and horses left on the ground, while the attackers bought the forts with their engines. Span: from the coalition's departure to the point where the Tang court stopped contesting the positions north of the Tarim, roughly two or three years.
cause: 動因有三層。表層是地盤：安史之亂把唐朝在西域的精兵抽空，763 年吐蕃取河西走廊後，長安與西域之間的陸路只剩穿越沙漠與山口的險道，運兵運糧的成本高到無法維持常駐軍隊，安西四鎮與北庭都護府只剩下名義。突騎施在 750 年代末已控制碎葉與怛羅斯一帶，唐朝靠冊封羈縻維持的宗主關係隨之惡化；蘇祿死後突騎施內部分裂，各部酋長各自與唐、阿兩方周旋，尋求更高的價碼。中層是阿拔斯的東進：呼羅珊王朝完成波斯本土的整合後，需要把木鹿、撒馬爾罕與內沙連成一條穩定的邊界，把中亞的粟特城邦收編進哈里發的版圖；費爾干納是通往天山南麓的門戶，拔汗那與碎葉的城國只要還向長安進貢，呼羅珊的邊境就永遠暴露在唐軍巡邏之下。深層是結構性的：唐廷自天寶十載怛羅斯之敗後已放棄西域的爭奪，778 年的形勢只是把既成事實補齊。這一次的進攻是一次典型的邊界清理，而不是新征服的開場：聯軍沒有足夠兵力深入塔里木盆地，因此唐廷的反應主要是議價而不是反攻。
causeEn: There were three layers of motive. On the surface, territory: the An Lushan rebellion emptied the Tang of its best troops in the West, and after 763 the Tibetans took the Hexi corridor, leaving only a hazardous road through desert and mountain passes between Chang'an and the western regions; the cost of moving men and grain along it was too high to sustain permanent garrisons, and the four garrisons of Anxi and the protectorate of Beiting survived as titles only. The Turgesh had controlled Suyab and Talas since the later 750s, and the suzerainty the Tang maintained by investiture turned hollow with it; after Suluk's death the Turgesh split, and each chieftain dealt with both the Tang and the Abbasids, looking for a better price. Below that lay the Abbasid advance to the east: once the Khurramite dynasty had consolidated Persian proper, it needed Merv, Samarkand and Nishapur joined into one stable frontier, bringing the Sogdian city-states inside the caliph's map. Fergana was the gate to the southern Tian Shan, and as long as Fergana and Suyab still sent tribute to Chang'an the Khurasan border stayed exposed to Tang patrols. At the bottom lay something structural: after the defeat at Talas in the tenth year of Tianbao the Tang had already given up the contest for the West, and the situation of 778 only completed a fait accompli. The offensive of 778 was a border clearance rather than the opening of a new conquest; the coalition lacked the strength to push deep into the Tarim basin, so the Tang answered by negotiation rather than by counterattack.
impact: 這場敗仗是唐朝在中亞的終點。此後唐朝在塔里木盆地以北再無成建制的據點，邊界退到龜茲、疏勒一線，碎葉與拔汗那的羈縻國失去宗主，實際落入突騎施與阿拔斯的勢力範圍；唐朝在中亞的影響力，連同安西四鎮那套百餘年的羈縻冊封網路，在費爾干納一線正式中斷。絲路並未因此中斷，貿易改由突騎施、粟特與阿拉伯商人主導，馬匹、鎧甲、琉璃、香料與絲織品仍然東來西往，但不再有唐朝的軍旗與官印隨商隊同行。對唐朝自身，這一仗也確認了帝國的邊界只能守到哪裡：此後數十年，河西與西域的經營重心轉向鹽池、吐蕃與南疆，朝廷再沒有能力在西域重建前線。對中亞本身，阿拔斯在費爾干納建立統治後，把唐朝百餘年的羈縻影響換成自己的宗主體系；此後喀拉汗王朝與嗶噠在九世紀爭奪河中，唐朝的舊藩屬在新的宗主之間重新分配，直到蒙古時代打通歐亞，這一帶才再被納入更大的帝國秩序。長期來看，778 年之後東西方的往來重心逐漸向海上傾斜，廣州、揚州與南海航線承擔了原先由陸路肩挑的絲綢與戰馬貿易。
impactEn: This defeat was the end of the Tang in Central Asia. After it the Tang held no organized positions north of the Tarim basin; the frontier fell back to the Kucha and Kashgar line, and the client states of Suyab and Fergana lost their overlord, passing in practice into the sphere of the Turgesh and the Abbasids. The Tang presence in Central Asia, together with the network of client investitures that had run for more than a century, was formally broken on the Fergana front. The Silk Road did not stop; the trade passed into the hands of Turgesh, Sogdian and Arab merchants, and horses, armour, lapis, spices and silk still moved in both directions, but the Tang banner and seal no longer travelled with the caravans. For the Tang itself the battle confirmed where the empire's frontier could be held: for the decades that followed, attention in the west shifted to the salt lakes, Tibet and the southern marches, and the court never again built a front line in the western regions. For Central Asia the Abbasid takeover in Fergana replaced more than a century of Tang client influence with a caliphal system of its own; the old Tang client states were then redistributed among new overlords as the Karakhanids and the Hephthalites fought over Transoxiana in the ninth century, and it took the Mongols, reopening the Eurasian circuit, to fold the region into a larger imperial order. In the long run, after 778, the weight of east-west exchange tilted toward the sea, and the routes through Guangzhou, Yangzhou and the South China Sea carried the silk and warhorse traffic that had previously been shouldered along the land road.
result: 聯軍完勝。唐軍在坦特基尼奇一線被擊潰，隊伍在費爾干納的山間谷地被打散，殘部退向塔里木盆地北緣，攻城方隨即以砲車與封鎖線拿下碎葉與拔汗那的城砦，唐朝退出費爾干納。聯軍同樣止步：兵力不足以穿越天山道深入塔里木，也沒有能力同時壓制龜茲、疏勒與吐蕃的牽制，因此戰役的結局不是瓜分，而是把邊界推到唐朝力所能及的極限之外。雙方隨後轉入以使節與物資交換為主的接觸：唐廷不再爭取已失的據點，阿拔斯也不接受唐朝的冊封，兩國在絲路上的往來反而延續了數百年，經由海路與陸路把東方的絲與瓷、中方的馬與琉璃送到巴格達、撒馬爾罕與碎葉。對兵器史而言，本役留下的是攻城砲車的示範：決定城砦歸屬的最終手段不是野戰裡的騎兵衝鋒，而是能把石頭送出城牆的機具；而唐軍的教訓，是把援兵送進沒有補給的山谷，再多準備的攻城器械也救不回來。
resultEn: The coalition won outright. The Tang force was destroyed in the line of Tondibi, broken up in the valleys of southern Fergana, and the survivors fell back to the northern rim of the Tarim; the attackers then took the forts of Suyab and Fergana with their engines and lines of blockade, and the Tang left Fergana. The coalition stopped just as surely: its numbers were not enough to force a way through the Tian Shan passes into the Tarim, nor to hold down Kucha, Kashgar and the Tibetans at the same time, so the outcome was not a partition but a frontier pushed to the limit of what the Tang could answer. From then on contact between the two sides turned to embassies and exchange of goods: the Tang court no longer fought for the positions it had lost, the Abbasids would not accept Tang investiture, and the traffic of the Silk Road continued for centuries, carrying eastern silk and porcelain, and central Asian horses and lapis, to Baghdad, Samarkand and Suyab by sea and by land. For the history of weapons the lesson of this campaign is a demonstration of the siege engine: what finally decided the forts was not the cavalry charge in the field but the machine that could put a stone over the wall; and the Tang lesson was that a relief army marched into a valley with no supplies cannot be saved by any number of siege engines.
